translations.answer: The contributors indicated that the root cause is not the simplified model, joint Kp/Kd, or lack of WBC, but rather the ZeroVelocityConstraint.positionErrorGain assumption of flat ground, which conflicts with the generated terrain. Users of flat ground should set generateTerrain=false; if rough terrain is needed, set ZeroVelocityConstraint.positionErrorGain=0.0. The original author later confirmed that the configuration works, but did not specify which one to use.
translations.applicability: Applies to the OCS2 legged_robot_raisim configuration with generated terrain; further verification for new versions and real-world terrain estimation is required.
translations.credibility.rationale: The issue has been closed, the environment is clear and there is no conflict. It has been formally documented or independently reproducible with precise references.
translations.details.attempts.0: The second representer asked whether joint Kp/Kd, RaiSim parameters, or WBC needed to be adjusted; the contributor explicitly stated these are not necessary for the fix.
translations.details.attempts.1: The original author modified the configuration as per the contributor's suggestion and retested.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Check if generateTerrain is enabled and if ZeroVelocityConstraint's positionErrorGain is still assumed to be flat ground.
translations.details.diagnostics.1: Verify the terrain assumption before adjusting Kp/Kd or implementing WBC by using the two mutually exclusive configurations provided in the thread.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Set raisim.info.generateTerrain to false if only flat ground is needed.
translations.details.effective_fixes.1: Set task.info.ZeroVelocityConstraint.positionErrorGain to 0.0 if rough terrain is needed.
translations.details.environments.0: OCS2 legged_robot_raisim example with generated terrain; original post did not provide OCS2 commit, RaiSim version, or robot parameters.
translations.details.limits.0: The thread does not specify which of the two configurations the original author ultimately used, nor does it provide the modified log.
translations.details.limits.1: The configuration link points to the main branch; the file location and parameter names of the target version need to be rechecked.
translations.details.limits.2: positionErrorGain=0.0 is a thread recommendation for the rough terrain example, and cannot be directly generalized to all foot position error feedback.
translations.details.outcomes.0: The original author replied that the configuration works and thanked the quick response.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: OCS2 legged_robot_raisim exhibits CoM drift, contact force oscillations, and leg lifting when no commands are given; should joint gains be adjusted or is the terrain/contact constraint configuration modified?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Before modifying contact position feedback in real-world or high-fidelity simulations, limit torque/velocity and validate foot penetration, sliding, and terrain estimation errors.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The contributor explicitly stated that the ZeroVelocityConstraint.positionErrorGain assumption is currently for flat ground, which conflicts with the generated terrain.
translations.details.symptoms.0: The robot's posture changes immediately upon simulation start, with CoM slightly moving in the x-direction, and the front leg contact force affecting the body's posture and causing slight oscillations.
translations.details.symptoms.1: No gait or trajectory command, but the right hind leg continues to lift, leading to a crash in the calculation.
translations.details.symptoms.2: The second user reported the same issue in the same thread.
translations.media_summaries.0: Original post PNG has been verified: in RViz, the robot shows multiple poses with a visible raised right hind foot and a green force arrow near the foot; no time, units, or configuration values are present, only supporting the symptoms of static state drift and leg lifting.
translations.media_summaries.1: The second user's GIF has been verified at two moments: the robot's posture changes significantly and shows artifacts, but the exact value of positionErrorGain cannot be determined from the image.
translations.source.locator: OCS2 #56: Contributor comment 1304459256 provides two configurations; original author comment 1304836921 confirms it.
